question: Will Spain's Congress convalidate Real Decreto-ley 29/2026 on the social function of housing before 13 November 2026?

calls.reasoning: Base rate: when a group of parties has publicly said it will vote for a decree-law and those votes add up to a majority, the decree is convalidated almost every time (~90%). For RDL 29/2026 the press count in the 69-seat Diputación Permanente is 35 in favour (PSOE 24, Sumar 6, ERC, Bildu, PNV, Podemos) vs 34 against (PP 27, Vox 6, Junts), and the PNV confirmed its yes vote on 6-8 October. Downward adjustments: the margin is one vote, so any absence, defection or abstention gives a 34-34 tie, which resolves NO. The Urda crash (28 Oct) has strained relations with Sumar, ERC and Podemos, though as of 29 Oct no ally had announced a change of vote. The 12 Nov session was not yet formally convened as of 30 Oct, and the government already postponed once (16 Oct). Counterweight: the anti-eviction decree matches the allies' own policy goals, and voting it down the day before the campaign opens would cost them with their voters. Market check: no Polymarket, Manifold or Kalshi market found, and no bookmaker found.
calls.dossier:
- Make-up of the Diputación Permanente (69 seats; Público, Filtrent, Oct 2026): PP 27, PSOE 24, Vox 6, Sumar 6, and one each for ERC, Bildu, PNV, Junts and Podemos. Bloc for RDL 29: PSOE+Sumar+ERC+Bildu+PNV+Podemos = 35. Against: PP+Vox+Junts = 34. A 34-34 tie means the decree is not convalidated.
- PNV confirmed it will vote yes on RDL 29 (eviction suspension for vulnerable people until 2030, limits on vulture-fund purchases to 2028) and no on RDL 28, the rental-stability decree (elDiario.es, Infobae, 6 Oct 2026; elEconomista 2026).
- Elplural (Oct 2026): Junts' vote is not needed in the Diputación Permanente, unlike in the plenary that rejected RDL 26/27 on 2 Oct (172-178, 166-184).
- The government withheld both housing decrees from the 16 Oct Diputación Permanente session, which convalidated DANA aid and other decrees instead (brainsre.news, democrata.es, alcalahoy, Oct 2026).
- The vote is planned for 12 Nov, one day after the 11 Nov general strike and one day before the campaign opens on 13 Nov (laregion, publico, eldiario, moncloa.com, 16-17 Oct 2026). As of 30 Oct the session was not yet formally convened (per question background).
- Urda crash, 28 Oct (69 dead). Sumar/Frente Amplio, Podemos and ERC requested that Puente appear. Esdiario (29 Oct) calls the crash a threat to the 35-34 majority but reports that no ally has announced a change of vote; PNV is pressing on Puente but has not withdrawn its support.
- Filtrent: the 35-34 figure is a press count, not a result; the margin is very narrow.
- Status quo: the decree is in force pending the vote; it lapses if not convalidated.
- Resolves off the Diputación Permanente Diario de Sesiones for the 12 Nov session (or credible press), not off the BOE derogation notice. A tie or a vote held after the deadline counts as NO.
- Event window: now -> 23:59 CET on 12 Nov 2026. As of 2 Nov, about 3 of the 37 days since 7 Oct publication remain (~73% of the 7 Oct -> 12 Nov span elapsed).
- Searched but not found: rules on substitutes or telematic voting in the Diputación Permanente; any explicit statement from ERC, Podemos or Bildu on their RDL 29 vote after Urda; any prediction market or bookmaker (none found).

calls.dossier:
- RDL 29/2026 (social function of housing / affordable supply) published in the BOE on 7 Oct 2026, in force 8 Oct; includes curbs on speculative purchases, a suspension of evictions of vulnerable people until 2030, a 10% rent deduction, a SOCIMI tax and a €2bn guarantee line (BOE; fiscal-impuestos.com).
- Diputación Permanente: 69 members = 68 MPs + Congress president Armengol (PSOE). PP 27, PSOE 25 incl. Armengol, Vox 6, Sumar 6, and one each for ERC, Bildu, PNV, Junts, Podemos (thespanisheye 6 Oct; eldebate/deia 16 Oct). Public breakdowns differ on PSOE 24 vs 25; the totals work only with 25.
- Supporting bloc PSOE+Sumar+ERC+Bildu+PNV+Podemos = 35; PP+Vox+Junts = 34. A 34-34 tie fails to convalidate.
- PNV confirmed on 6 Oct it will vote yes on the main decree (RDL 29) 'for coherence and responsibility' and no on the rental decree RDL 28 (eldiario.es, Infobae, Libertad Digital, 6-8 Oct).
- In the 2 Oct plenary the near-identical RDL 26/27 were defeated 172-178 and 166-184; the parties above voted yes on the first decree.
- Session expected on 12 Nov, the day after the 11 Nov general strike and the day before the campaign starts on 13 Nov; 13 Nov is the constitutional deadline (laregion 16 Oct; Infobae/Europa Press 27 Oct; elriu.cat). Not formally convened as of 30 Oct.
- After the Urda train crash on 28 Oct (69 dead), Sumar, ERC and Podemos demanded explanations; the PNV said political responsibility could reach Puente. esdiario (29 Oct) found no announced withdrawal of support on the housing decrees, only that 'if one member changes position the balance can flip'. Puente appears on 3 Nov.
- Groups on the Diputación Permanente have designated substitutes (general practice, not verified for this session).
- Status quo: the decree is in force and needs a positive vote on 12 Nov; with no vote or a tie it lapses.
- Resolves off the Diputación Permanente Diario de Sesiones / credible reporting of the 12 Nov vote on RDL 29 specifically, not RDL 28.
- Event window: 7 Oct 2026 -> 23:59 Madrid 12 Nov 2026 per the criteria; as of 2 Nov ~70% elapsed; the only realistic vote date is 12 Nov.
- Searched without finding: any explicit threat by Podemos, ERC, Bildu or Sumar to vote against RDL 29; any Junts shift; any prediction market (none on Polymarket/Manifold); a formal convocation of the 12 Nov session.

- Diputación Permanente (DP) composition: 69 members: PP 27, PSOE 24, Vox 6, Sumar 6, and one each for ERC, Bildu, PNV, Junts and Podemos. Government side 35, PP+Vox+Junts 34. A tie does not convalidate (Público; elDiario.es, Oct 2026).

calls.reconciliation: The runs differed only by judgment (0.83-0.86); no factual dispute changes the count. The PSOE 24 vs 25 discrepancy is settled by arithmetic: the 24-seat breakdown sums to 68, so the 69th member is Congress president Armengol (PSOE), and the 35-34 count stands. PNV's yes on RDL 29 is confirmed in every dossier. All runs report the same absence of ally threats after the Urda crash, and none found a market. Whether substitutes cover absences is unverified but plausible. I weigh the one-vote margin, the deadline-day timing and an unconvened session as the residual ~16% risk, consistent with a pre-announced majority base rate of ~90% minus razor-thin margin effects.
